note: Live off-air decode by navtex.lv, pasted from the site's PDF export on 2026-09-08; '_' = unrecoverable characters, garbage runs = decoder substitutions. AREA U here is Mondolfo Radio (Italy, NAVAREA III, station U), not Tallinn — night skywave into Latvia. Timestamp LV (UTC+3) → UTC. HA86 is a NAVWARN about an UNAUTHORIZED station broadcasting NAVTEX — a real spoofing case for the dual-use story.
